text.tspan: Dallas Office Memo
To:J. E. Patton
From:Marty Pennock
Subject:Bug List for DITEK DynaCADD and Soft Logik PageStream 2.1
Date:April 2, 1992
ccTom Ulaszek - ATX
Ira Goldstein - ATX
The following is a set of bugs we have noticed here at ATX with PageStream and DynaCADD.
DynaCADD
1.When exporting a drawing in GEM output, the file cannot be loaded into Avant Vektor or
Easy Draw without being upside down or inverted. Even when flip, mirror, and other
options are selected in DynaCADD before the output is started. DITEK has had my
distribution disks for over three months. Dave Fletcher in their Tech. Support department
was supposed to work on it and apply a fix. I have phoned Dave several times, no response
to messages and he is never in the office. Meanwhile, no distribution disks. If the system
crashes here, I am out of luck with nothing more than a hopefully good archive set.
PageStream
1.When importing GEM Metafiles from Easy Draw, the fonts used in Easy Draw do not
transfer correctly. They are not sized, not justified, and run all over the objects they are used
in or on.
2.When files are imported from DynaCADD, they must be selected, ungrouped, lines styles
and colors must be set before the drawing even becomes visible on the screen.
3.If you import a GEM drawing form DynaCADD, Easy Draw, or even one created with
PageStream itself, sometimes, depending on the drawing and the size, the file cannot be
accessed again after quitting. A page is started when you try to open the file and a #2 or #3
exception is displayed and you are dumped back out to the desktop. The file is lost forever.
The only way around this is to craete everything on the page as an object, including text.
You loose all text manipulation features and it is very slow and tedious.
4.When importing multiple GEM files into a document and using the Text Runaround feature,
after a certain point, it can even be in the beginning after only one or two drawings, the text
runaround feature stops working. You can select it but nothing happens.
5.Sometimes when editing a document with a GEM drawing and you try to change the font in
a text object, the font choices dialoge box will appear with only numbers and garbage for
choices. The application must be closed and started again to get the font choices back.
